bib.title: An In-depth Look at Gemini’s Language Abilities

question: How do Gemini Pro and the OpenAI GPT 3.5 Turbo / GPT 4 Turbo models compare on language tasks when all are run with the same prompts and evaluation, and where does each excel?
hypothesis: Implied: Google's first-party claim that Gemini Pro is comparable to GPT 3.5 Turbo may not hold under independent, identical-prompt evaluation.
contributions: A third-party, objective comparison of OpenAI GPT and Google Gemini models with reproducible code and fully transparent results.
An in-depth analysis of the results, identifying areas where one of the two model classes excels.

method.summary: Four models (Gemini Pro, GPT 3.5 Turbo, GPT 4 Turbo, Mixtral) were queried through LiteLLM on 10 datasets spanning knowledge QA, reasoning, math, code, translation and web agents, with identical prompts and evaluators drawn from standard repositories (sometimes the Gemini team's recommended prompts). Results are broken down by question length, answer type, subtask and other slices with the Zeno tool.
method.task: Benchmarking of LLM language abilities (MMLU, BBH, GSM8K, SVAMP, ASDIV, MAWPS, HumanEval, ODEX, FLORES-200, WebArena)

datasets.name: MMLU
datasets.preprocessing: 5-shot standard prompts; also 5-shot CoT from chain-of-thought-hub

datasets.name: BIG-Bench Hard
datasets.preprocessing: 3-shot CoT from Eleuther harness; answer matching changed to last word for multiple-choice tasks

datasets.name: GSM8K, SVAMP, ASDIV, MAWPS
datasets.preprocessing: 8-shot CoT; answer = last number in generated text

datasets.name: HumanEval
datasets.preprocessing: rudimentary post-processing: strip markdown code blocks, extract function, truncate trailing prose; missing imports not fixed

datasets.name: FLORES-200
datasets.size: 1012 test sentences per language pair, 20 languages (English to X only)
datasets.source: NLLB Team 2022; language subset from Robinson et al. 2023

datasets.name: WebArena
datasets.preprocessing: observation limit 1920 tokens using gpt-4-1106-preview tokenizer

other.safety: safety filters disabled for main results; gemini-pro-filtered = filters on

other.note: WebArena observation limit uses tokenizer of gpt-4-1106-preview

models.name: Mixtral
models.architecture: sparse mixture of experts, 8 groups of parameters, two used per token

inference.decoding: greedy (temperature 0) for MMLU, BBH, math, code; temperature 0.3 for translation; provider defaults for WebArena
inference.samples: one response per item; no self-consistency or multiple sampling; no seeds or repeated runs stated
inference.prompting: few-shot: MMLU 5-shot (and 5-shot CoT with 'Let's think step by step.'), BBH 3-shot CoT, math 8-shot CoT, code zero-shot, FLORES 5-shot (zero-shot in Appendix C), WebArena 2-shot CoT with and without UA hint

other.pricing_per_1M_tokens_input_output: Gemini Pro $1.00/$2.00 (character price x4); GPT 3.5 Turbo $1.00/$2.00; GPT 4 Turbo $10.00/$30.00; Mixtral $0.60/$0.60

metrics.name: Accuracy
metrics.definition: MMLU: first generated character (5-shot) or extracted answer with default 'C' (CoT); BBH: last word for multiple-choice else 'So the answer is' match; math: last number in output

metrics.name: Pass@1
metrics.definition: execution-based, single output passes test cases

metrics.name: chrF (chrF2++)
metrics.definition: sentence-level averaged, sacreBLEU implementation, character and word n-gram overlap

metrics.name: Success rate (SR)
metrics.definition: WebArena execution-based; task counts as success if the final goal is achieved

eval.protocol: Single run per model and dataset; same prompts and evaluators for all models; no significance tests or confidence intervals; results as of 27 December 2023.

availability.data: results and model predictions in the repo and Zeno online report browser

prompts.text:
Write the following python3 function:
[CODE BLOCK]

This is an English to [TGT] translation, please provide the [TGT] translation for this sentence. Do not provide any explanations or text apart from the translation.
[SRC]: [src-sentence]
[TGT]:

This is an English to [TGT] translation, please provide the [TGT] translation for these sentences:
[SRC]: [src-sentence] [TGT]: [tgt-sentence] [repeated five times, paraphrase]
Please provide the translation for the following sentence. Do not provide any explanations or text apart from the translation.
[SRC]: [src-sentence]
[TGT]:

limits: Snapshot of ever-changing API systems, results current as of 27 December 2023 and may change as models are upgraded; exact API model version strings are not given.
Results depend on the chosen prompts and generation parameters; all models were affected by prompt selection and GPT models seemed more robust to small prompt variations.

No self-consistency or multi-sample decoding, unlike the Gemini report, so numbers are not comparable to Google's own and the authors say results could change significantly with more prompt engineering.
Data leakage was not measured; mitigated only by breadth of tasks and WebArena.
Numbers are lower than those in the Gemini and Mixtral technical reports (MMLU, HumanEval), attributed to prompt sensitivity; HumanEval gap unresolved.
Single run, no confidence intervals or significance tests; many differences are 1-4 points.
Gemini Ultra not tested (not publicly available); multimodal ability excluded; translation limited to English to X.
Gemini Pro safety filters were disabled for main results, but blocked responses still hit low-resource languages; with filters on, response rate and scores drop.
WebArena hyperparameters differ between Gemini (temp 0.9, top-p 1.0) and GPT (temp 1.0, top-p 0.9) runs, so that comparison is not hyperparameter-identical.
Some evaluator changes (BBH last-word, math last-number) deviate from the Eleuther harness defaults to avoid penalising format.
Mixtral version was initially a third-party non-official one; v2 corrected it.
